# Fund Account APIs

A Fund Account is an entity to which payouts are made. To make a payout to a contact, you must add a fund account to the contact. Use our APIs to perform these actions or access them directly from the  [RazorpayX Dashboard](https://x.razorpay.com/auth).

## Fund Account APIs

The table below lists the various endpoints and gives a brief description of each:

API Endpoint | Description
---
[Create a Fund Account using Bank Account details](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/fund-accounts/create/bank-account.md) | Creates a new fund account using bank account details.
---
[Create a Fund Account using VPA](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/fund-accounts/create/vpa.md) | Creates a new fund account using VPA.
---
[Activate or Deactivate a Fund Account](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/fund-accounts/activate-or-deactivate.md) | Activates or deactivates an existing fund account.
---
[Fetch all Fund Accounts](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/fund-accounts/fetch-all.md) | Retrieves all the fund accounts.
---
[Fetch a Fund Account with ID](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/fund-accounts/fetch-with-id.md) | Retrieves a single fund account with ID.
---
